news.h: Giants' Malik Nabers takes issue with Greg Olsen, Fox for comments during game
news.d: Malik Nabers took issue with Fox play-by-play man Joe Davis and analyst Greg Olsen for criticizing his body language during the Giants' win Sunday.

news.h: Giants' Cam Skattebo doubtful vs. Eagles; Malik Nabers 'full go'
news.d: Giants running back Cam Skattebo is unlikely to play against the Eagles on Sunday, but receiver Malik Nabers is expected to be a "full go" without limitations.
